notes: Income Tax Department refund phishing email; recipient name and address are blurred on the page. […] marks text hidden on the page itself (FAKE stamp, blur or an overlay); nothing was filled in. Transcribed by hand from a screenshot published on the page and cross-checked against Windows OCR. Line breaks follow the screenshot where they separate fields; wrapped lines are joined. Page number is the PDF page (1-based). The year of tweets shown without a year is inferred from the compilation's reverse-date order (it was made on 2024-02-02).
